title: SchemaApplyFailed payload
description: EKR could not read the ontology, begin the stage, take the snapshot, mint an id or answer a transaction: nothing was published, the stage was abandoned, or on `sqlite` the snapshot taken before was restored, and every approved proposal is still `approved`. Or, after the changes were published, EKR could not read the store's head or `proposals.jsonl` could not be written: the changes stay in the store, and the reason says so and names the revision (on `postgres`, the head the stage was published at; on `sqlite`, the last committed one), or, when no proposal was applied, says no change was committed.
